title: Creole dance halls of downtown New Orleans
summary: She lists halls such as L'Amitie, Perseverance, Artisans, L'Equite and Sincere, and locates them.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Did they have any regular dance halls open to the public when you were young? How far back?
Oh, yes. Oh, yes.
I wondered, were they just the dances? They had the big balls in the homes?
Balls. The Mardi Gras carnival? Not in the, they didn't give balls in the homes.
No, but I mean the other.
In them halls, yes.
The party. Did they dance at the homes for parties or not sometimes?
Oh, yes. Oh, they danced from the time they got in till the time the musicians would take the instruments to go.
I wondered if they had any dance halls when you were young, like the Globe Hall, you know?
Oh, yes. They had L'Amitié. They had Perseverance. They had Artisans. How do they call that little hall on Robinson Street? L'Equite. L'Equite.
L'Equite.
L'Equite. L'Equite.
New hall. Artisan hall.
New hall is Artisan.
Did you go to the Mississippi Valley Hall? No.
No, that was after my time. Not in my time.
No, they had so many halls. Most of the people, most of the people of downtown, the Creole people, still there are more than they searching, you know?
L'Espérance, L'Espérance, Artisan, Perseverance, L'Equite. Sincère.
Well, where was that?
Sincère was on the clebond between Columbus. Yes. Somewhere where that church is, where that…
Between Columbus and La Hoppe.
Eh?
Between Columbus and La Hoppe.
Between Col… oh no, it was not as…
Between Calarick and Columbus.
Calarick, yes.
Yeah, where the Union is now. Yeah, on this side of… Yes. On the light side of the road.
That where they got the… they got a… a society deck. Where is it?
Where are those two on the other?
On… on… on… on… on… Progressive.

They had a hall… I can't remember the name. D'Anterial Church… Preston, Villery, Robinson and between Columbus, between St. Andes. No hallway, no dog people was allowed. From Zambia? From Zambia. Did you go to some sort of French school when you were a child?
